reserveReview.rationale: Re-reviewed 2026-08-29. Forte's current transparency page still states that AUDF is 100% backed by AUD held with regulated financial institutions but publishes no newer dated reserve report. The latest reachable artifact is the AUDF Reserves Report for 31 May 2026, accompanied by Horizon Nexus (Audit) Pty Ltd's independent auditor's report signed in Melbourne on 16 June 2026. Horizon Nexus audits the reported AUD reserve bank-account balance of AUD 5,136,311.71 under Australian Auditing Standards; the report supports one 100% AUD bank-cash slice and states that the reserve is segregated and unencumbered, but it does not identify the bank or provide provider-level allocations. The compositionAsOf therefore remains 2026-05-31 and is outside the 31-day plus seven-day static-composition admission window as of this review; no current composition is asserted.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Horizon Nexus independent audit of the AUDF reserve bank-account cash balance as of 2026-05-31; Forte transparency page re-opened 2026-08-29
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The complete reserve asset class is identified as an AUD bank-account cash balance. The bank identity, provider concentration, and account terms remain undisclosed custody details.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Management and Horizon Nexus describe one segregated, unencumbered AUDF reserve bank account in Australia but do not name the bank, disclose provider allocations, establish statutory bankruptcy remoteness or trust status for token holders, or state anti-rehypothecation / successor-custody terms. Binding terms deny holders a security interest or trust/fiduciary claim on reserves.
